tokens.name: ds-bg
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: ds-bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Subtle zones and table headers.

tokens.name: ds-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals, and the fill of form controls.

tokens.name: ds-surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on surfaces, list items, ghost and secondary buttons; neutral Badge ground.

tokens.name: ds-border
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and resting card edges. Not for control outlines.

tokens.name: ds-border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasis dividers. Not for control outlines.

tokens.name: ds-text
tokens.usage: Body and UI text on ds-bg, ds-surface, ds-surface-hover and ds-bg-subtle (light ds-bg 17.9:1, ds-surface 17.9:1, ds-surface-hover 16.3:1, ds-bg-subtle 17.1:1; dark ds-bg 19.3:1, ds-surface 17.1:1, ds-surface-hover 14.0:1, ds-bg-subtle 17.1:1).

tokens.name: ds-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, decorative icons, inactive tabs, on ds-bg and ds-surface (light ds-bg 4.8:1, ds-surface 4.8:1; dark ds-bg 7.9:1, ds-surface 7.0:1). Misses 4.5:1 on ds-surface-hover in light (4.34:1): use ds-text-secondary on tinted grounds.

tokens.name: ds-text-on-accent
tokens.usage: White text and marks on ds-primary-solid and ds-danger-solid (light ds-primary-solid 5.2:1, ds-danger-solid 4.8:1; dark ds-primary-solid 5.2:1, ds-danger-solid 4.8:1). Also the check mark on a checked Checkbox (ds-primary).

tokens.name: ds-primary
tokens.usage: The one accent: links, active state, selection, checked Checkbox/Radio/Switch. Behind white text use ds-primary-solid. As active-nav text on ds-primary-subtle: light 4.7:1, dark 2.8:1 (misses 4.5:1 in dark; kept as the source has it).

tokens.name: ds-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover shade of ds-primary.

tokens.name: ds-primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Active nav item, info Alert, primary Badge and Avatar grounds.

tokens.name: ds-success
tokens.usage: Success status fills and marks. On ds-success-subtle use ds-success-text.

tokens.name: ds-success-subtle
tokens.usage: Success Alert and Badge ground.

tokens.name: ds-warning
tokens.usage: Warning status fills and marks. On ds-warning-subtle use ds-warning-text.

tokens.name: ds-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Warning Alert and Badge ground.

tokens.name: ds-danger
tokens.usage: Danger status, invalid-field border, notification dot. On ds-danger-subtle use ds-danger-text.

tokens.name: ds-danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Danger Alert and Badge ground.

tokens.name: ds-focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline at 2px offset (0 on inputs, with the border recoloured). On ds-bg: light 3.7:1, dark 7.9:1.

tokens.name: ds-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Muted text that must also work on tinted grounds; neutral Badge text (light ds-surface-hover 6.9:1, ds-bg-subtle 7.2:1, ds-surface 7.6:1; dark ds-surface-hover 9.9:1, ds-bg-subtle 12.0:1, ds-surface 12.0:1).

tokens.name: ds-border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of every form control (input, select, textarea, checkbox, radio, switch off track, secondary Button). On ds-surface: light 3.2:1, dark 3.1:1.

tokens.name: ds-primary-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary Button, behind ds-text-on-accent.

tokens.name: ds-primary-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary Button.

tokens.name: ds-primary-subtle-text
tokens.usage: Accent text on ds-primary-subtle: Badge, info Alert, Avatar initials (light ds-primary-subtle 6.2:1; dark ds-primary-subtle 5.7:1).

tokens.name: ds-success-text
tokens.usage: Success text on ds-success-subtle (light ds-success-subtle 4.8:1; dark ds-success-subtle 6.8:1).

tokens.name: ds-warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on ds-warning-subtle (light ds-warning-subtle 4.8:1; dark ds-warning-subtle 7.3:1).

tokens.name: ds-danger-text
tokens.usage: Danger text on ds-danger-subtle (light ds-danger-subtle 5.9:1; dark ds-danger-subtle 4.7:1).

tokens.name: ds-danger-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of the danger Button, behind ds-text-on-accent.

tokens.name: ds-chart-primary
tokens.usage: Fill of data marks: bars, columns, the sparkline end dot, the tooltip key stroke. On ds-surface: light 5.2:1, dark 4.9:1 (marks need 3:1). Never use it for chart text; labels use the text tokens.

tokens.name: ds-chart-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered or focused data mark. On ds-surface: light 6.7:1, dark 7.0:1.

tokens.name: ds-chart-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasis gray for marks that are context: the other bars when one is highlighted, the sparkline line. On ds-surface: light 3.2:1, dark 3.8:1.

tokens.name: ds-chart-muted-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered or focused de-emphasis mark. On ds-surface: light 4.8:1, dark 7.0:1.

tokens.name: ds-space-5

tokens.name: ds-space-6

tokens.name: ds-space-20

tokens.name: ds-space-24

tokens.name: ds-radius-none
tokens.usage: Square corners.

tokens.name: ds-radius-sm
tokens.usage: 4px. Checkbox box, small chips.

tokens.name: ds-radius-md
tokens.usage: 8px. Buttons, inputs, selects, alerts.

tokens.name: ds-radius-lg
tokens.usage: 12px. Cards, panels, modals.

tokens.name: ds-radius-xl
tokens.usage: 16px. Large panels.

tokens.name: ds-radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, badges, switches, radios.

tokens.name: ds-shadow-xl

tokens.name: ds-container-md
tokens.usage: Text and forms.

tokens.name: ds-container-lg

tokens.name: ds-container-xl
tokens.usage: Wide app layouts.
